title: 第1351章 真是遭老罪咯第1350章 稍微满足一下魔体
slug: 我都无敌了要你这系统有何用
content_zh:
“咳咳咳！”
“罗师弟！张师兄！你们在哪？！”
好不容易从尘埃碎石堆里，费力爬出来，嘴角还残留着一抹猩红鲜血，脸上较为惨白的一位内门弟子！
此时他好不容易站直身体，并且抬手捂着胸口，大口喘着粗气，眼中的担忧与慌乱几乎要化为了实质！
哗啦…！
就在这位内门弟子，不顾引动体内伤势，强行催动体内残存不多的神力，于高空之上努力寻找着‘罗睺’，以及另外一位同门师兄的时候！
远处碎石泥土被微微掀起的声音，瞬间传到了这人的耳中！
听到声音的瞬间，这位太瑶神宫的内门弟子，因为一时情绪激动，导致气血略微上涌，脸色又白上一分的他，连忙向着声音传来的方向快速飞去！
在看到是自己的师兄，正艰难从碎石泥土堆里，想要爬出来的时候，这位内门弟子连忙把他从地里给刨了出来！
噗…！
一道吐血的声音瞬间传来！
“张师兄，张师兄你怎么样了？没事吧？！”
“无…无事！一时半会还死不了！”
这位被称呼为张师兄的内门弟子，此时灰头土脸，身上衣物早已经破烂不堪！
他才被师弟从碎石堆里给拉出来的瞬间，因为刚才他所受到的冲击最重，五脏六腑近乎碎裂，这才又猛的吐出一大口鲜血！
“师兄！快，快把丹药服下，先稳住伤势！”
“好！”
看着师弟递过来的疗伤丹药，这位张师兄二话不说，连忙接过直接塞进了嘴里！
随着丹药入喉，温和的药力开始滋养恢复所受到的伤势，原本脸上没有丝毫血色的这位张师兄，他缓缓吐出了一口浊气，眼中多少浮现出一丝神采！
“师弟！罗师弟呢？！”

“他怎么样了？！”
“还有那个魔族，他现在是死是活？！”
刚微微稳住体内伤势的这位张师兄，他连忙看向一旁，同样往自己嘴里塞下疗伤丹药的师弟，脸上早已满是急切与担忧！
听到询问，这位内门弟子的脸色瞬间就变得极其低沉，他看着周围那惨不忍睹的残垣断壁，无助的轻轻摇头！
“师兄！我…我现在也不知道，罗师弟到底是生是死！”
“至于那个魔族，应该是化为灰烬了吧？从我爬出来到现在，都感觉不到他半点的魔气！”
“刚才好似毁天灭地的一击，大概率是宫主给予罗师弟的保命底牌，我从那一击中能清楚的感受到，宫主那磅礴深邃的无边神力！”
“被宫主的全力一击正面打中，那个魔族不可能有任何生还的可能！”
听到师弟的话后，这位张师兄脸色凝重的轻轻点头！
从他被拉出来的时候，这位张师兄也是瞬间全力释放自身神念探查！
一，是为了确认罗睺师弟当前的情况！
二，是为了确认那个魔族到底死干净了没有？！
如今他也感受不到，之前那个魔族一丝一毫的气息，想必是死得透透的了！
“师弟，别愣着！”
“快！快找！一定要把罗睺师弟找到，活要见人，死要见尸！”
“罗睺师弟是宫主的亲传弟子，而且这还是他第一次离开神宫外出历练！”
“已经有好几位师兄弟死于魔族之手，要是罗睺师弟真出了什么闪失，咱们怎么跟宫主交代？！”
话落！
content_en:
"Cough cough cough!"
"Junior Brother Luo! Senior Brother Zhang! Where are you?!"
An inner disciple who finally crawled out from the pile of dust and rubble with a trace of scarlet blood on the corner of his mouth and a rather pale face!
At this time, he finally stood up straight and raised his hands to cover his chest, breathing heavily. The worry and panic in his eyes almost turned into reality!
Wow...!
Just when this inner disciple, regardless of causing injuries in his body, forcefully mobilized the few remaining divine powers in his body, he was trying hard to find 'Rahu' and another fellow disciple at high altitudes!
The sound of gravel and soil being stirred up in the distance instantly reached this man's ears!
The moment he heard the sound, this inner disciple of Taiyao Shrine was so excited that his energy and blood surged slightly, and his face turned pale again. He quickly flew towards the direction where the sound came from!
When he saw his senior brother struggling to crawl out from the pile of gravel and dirt, the inner disciple quickly dug him out of the ground!
puff…!
A sound of vomiting blood came instantly!
"Senior Brother Zhang, how are you doing, Senior Brother Zhang? Are you okay?!"
"No...nothing! I won't be dead for a while!"
This inner disciple, who was called Senior Brother Zhang, was now disgraced and his clothes were already in tatters!
The moment he was pulled out of the rubble by his junior brother, because he had received the heaviest impact just now, his internal organs were almost shattered, and then he spat out a large mouthful of blood!
"Senior brother! Quick, take the elixir and stabilize the injury first!"
"Okay!"
Looking at the healing elixir handed over by his junior brother, Senior Brother Zhang quickly took it and stuffed it into his mouth without saying a word!
As the elixir entered his throat, the mild medicinal power began to nourish and heal the injuries. Senior Brother Zhang, who had no color on his face at first, slowly exhaled a breath of turbid air, and a hint of sparkle appeared in his eyes!
"Junior brother! Where is Junior Brother Luo?!"
"How is he?!"
"And that demon, is he dead or alive now?!"
Senior Brother Zhang, who had just stabilized his internal injuries, quickly looked aside to see Junior Brother who also stuffed the healing elixir into his mouth. His face was already full of eagerness and worry!
Upon hearing the inquiry, the inner disciple's face instantly became extremely gloomy. He looked at the miserable ruins around him and shook his head helplessly!
"Senior Brother! I...I don't know now whether Junior Brother Luo is alive or dead!"
"As for that demon, it should have been reduced to ashes, right? From the time I crawled out until now, I can't feel any of his demonic energy!"
"The blow that seemed to destroy the world just now was most likely the Palace Master's life-saving trump card given to Junior Brother Luo. I can clearly feel the Palace Master's majestic and profound boundless divine power from that blow!"
"Hit head-on by the Palace Master's full blow, that demon has no chance of surviving!"
After hearing what his junior brother said, Senior Brother Zhang nodded slightly with a solemn expression!
When he was pulled out, Senior Brother Zhang also instantly released all his spiritual power to explore!
One, to confirm the current situation of Junior Brother Luo Hu!
Second, is it to confirm whether the demon is dead? !
Now he can't feel the slightest breath of the demon before, he must be completely dead!
"Junior brother, don't be stunned!"
"Quick! Find him quickly! We must find Junior Brother Luo Hu. We must see him alive, and his body must be seen if he dies!"
"Junior brother Luo Hu is the palace master's personal disciple, and this is the first time he has left the palace for training!"
"Several senior brothers have already died at the hands of demons. If junior brother Luo Hu really makes a mistake, how can we explain to the palace master?!"
The words have fallen!
